# Miya SOFT Exit Timing

The premium Miya pattern is patience: leave early enough to keep the second damage window alive.

## What to watch

- Do not mirror the frontline's first step into vision.
- Keep one firing lane untouched for the re-entry.
- Spend mobility on shape, not on panic pursuit.

## SOFT angle

SOFT mode elevates Miya because patient carries create cleaner second entries than flashy first ones.

> Her best damage starts after the fight has already lost its shape.

More on Miya: keep this read connected to marksman gold structures, not just isolated mechanics.
